info.name: SBI General - Motor Private Car (PMCAR001) UAT
info.description:
End-to-end SBI General **private car** motor journey on UAT: token -> quick quote -> full quote -> issuance -> policy PDF.

Built from the `SBIG_PMCAR01_Motor_JSON_Integration_Kit_Client` kit (product `PMCAR001`, risk `R10005`, agreement code `6660`). Every code in the sample payloads is resolved from the kit's own `Master_datatables` rather than invented:

- Vehicle - Maruti Suzuki (`18`) Alto (`83`) Std (`1413`): 796cc petrol hatchback, 5 seats, flagged Active/Active in `SBI_T_Variant_4W`.
- RTO - `MH-12` Pune: `Location_ID` 421, `District_Code` DS_286, cluster `MH_PUN`, region West, `Zone A`.
- Branch - Maharashtra, GSTIN `27AAMCS8857L1ZC` from `SBI_T_State`.

### Running it

Select the `SBI General - Motor UAT` environment, then run the folders in order. Each step feeds the next through collection variables (`accessToken` -> `idv` -> `quotationNo` -> `duePremium` -> `policyNo`), so the whole collection runs top-to-bottom in the Collection Runner.

### Dates

The collection-level pre-request script derives every date at send time, so the saved payloads never go stale: risk starts tomorrow and runs a year, the expiring policy is the year before it, and first registration is `vehicleAgeMonths` (default 18) before risk start.

### Gotchas worth knowing

- SBI returns business, validation and underwriting failures **inside an HTTP 200**. Every test script logs `ErrorList` / `ValidationResult`, and Issuance warns when `AutoUwResultCode != 1`.
- `Amount` on Issuance must equal the latest Full Quote `DuePremium`.
- The field names `AdditonalCompDeductible` and `RTOCityDistric` are misspelled in SBI's own schema. Sending the corrected spelling silently drops the value.
- Policy type drives cover periods: Package (`1`) is 1yr OD/TP/PA, Bundled (`6`) is 1yr OD + 3yr TP, and the liability-only types need the OD covers *removed* from the JSON rather than zeroed.

exec: // Derive the SBI request header and every date the payloads need, so the
// Risk period: starts tomorrow, runs one year (Package).
const start = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate() + 1);
const end = new Date(start.getFullYear() + 1, start.getMonth(), start.getDate() - 1);
// Expiring policy: the year immediately before the new risk period.
const preStart = new Date(start.getFullYear() - 1, start.getMonth(), start.getDate());
const preEnd = new Date(start.getFullYear(), start.getMonth(), start.getDate() - 1);
// First registration, `vehicleAgeMonths` before risk start. Keep this under
// 36 months or SBI starts declining the age-limited add-on covers.
const registered = new Date(start.getFullYear(), start.getMonth() - ageMonths, start.getDate());
// A fresh payment reference per run keeps UAT receipts from colliding.
// Warn early rather than letting a stale token produce a confusing 401.
console.warn("Access token has expired - run 01 - Auth / Generate Token again.");

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description: WSO2/IBM gateway token, valid for 7200s. Every other call needs it as a Bearer token **plus** the two `X-IBM-*` headers.

request.description:
GET, no body. Returns `{ "access_token": "...", "expire_in": 7200 }`.

The test script stores the token in the `accessToken` collection variable, which the collection-level Bearer auth reads.

item.name: 02 - Quote
item.description: Quick Quote is a pricing probe and persists nothing. Full Quote persists the proposal and returns the `QuotationNo` that Issuance consumes.

pm.test("JSON body", () => pm.expect(parsed, "response was not JSON").to.not.be.null);
// Business, validation and UW failures arrive inside a 200. Log them verbatim.
const problems = json.ErrorList || json.errorList || json.Errors || json.ValidationResult || json.MessageList;
// The first call leaves IDV_User unset so SBI returns its own IDV band;
// carry the suggestion forward so the Full Quote can pin the IDV.

request.description:
Statutory minimum Package cover set:

| Cover | Code | Benefits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Own Damage | `C101064` | `B00002` Own Damage Basic (`Price` = ex-showroom) |
| Legal Liability to Third Party | `C101065` | `B00008` TP Bodily Injury (SI 9999999), `B00009` TP Property Damage (SI 750000) |
| PA Cover | `C101066` | `B00015` PA Owner-Driver (SI 1500000 + nominee) |

`IDV_User` is deliberately **not** sent here, so SBI returns `IDV_Suggested` / `MinIDV_Suggested` / `MaxIDV_Suggested`. The test script stores the suggestion into `idv` for the Full Quote to pin.

request.description:
The same risk with the optional covers layered on:

| Cover | Code | Age limit (UW-BUSI RULES) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Depreciation Reimbursement (zero-dep) | `C101072` | not allowed at vehicle age >= 5 |
| Return to Invoice | `C101067` | not allowed at vehicle age >= 3 |
| Key Replacement | `C101073` | - |
| Inconvenience Allowance | `C101074` | SI must be 1000 / 2000 / 3000 |
| Loss of Personal Belongings | `C101075` | - |
| Engine Guard | `C101108` | not allowed at vehicle age >= 5 |
| Cover for consumables | `C101111` | - |
| Basic Road Side Assistance | `C101069` | not allowed at vehicle age >= 8 |

The default `vehicleAgeMonths` is 18, so every one of these is inside its window. Raise it and SBI starts rejecting covers.

request.description:
Optional. Re-prices an existing quote in place by echoing `QuotationNo` back in the body - use it when the customer changes IDV, deductible or add-ons before paying.

It returns the same `QuotationNo` with a fresh `DuePremium`, so re-run this (not the create) after any edit, otherwise Issuance collects the stale amount.

request.description:
`Amount` **must** equal the `DuePremium` from the latest Full Quote. The collection variable is set automatically, so re-run the Full Quote after any change.

Payment fields come from the BCP masters shipped in the kit:

- `PayMode` - `SBI_T_BCP_PayMode`. `103` Cheque (the kit sample), `113` Internetbanking, `105`/`110` Credit Card, `212` EFT. For an online aggregator journey `113` is the realistic value.
- `RemitBankAccount` - `SBI_T_BCP_RemitBankAccount`. `8` = HDFC Premium Collection A/C 7513.
- `LocationType` - `SBI_T_BCP_LocationType`. `1` = Local Cheque, own bank/branch.

On success the response carries `PolicyNo`, `ProposalNo`, `ProposalStatus` (`3`) and `AutoUwResultCode`. A UW referral comes back here rather than as an HTTP error, so check `AutoUwResultCode` before telling the customer they are covered.

item.name: 04 - Policy document
item.description: Two independent ways to fetch the policy schedule PDF. The plain one is enough for most journeys; the encrypted one is the newer "PDF 2.0" service keyed by agreement code.

request.description: Returns `getPolicyDocumentResponseBody.payload.URL` as a two-element array: `[filename, base64Pdf]`.

exec: // AES-256-GCM on top of CryptoJS (Postman ships crypto-js, which has no GCM).
// Verified against SBI's own sample ciphertext in "encrypted-get-pdf.txt".
const cfg = { mode: CryptoJS.mode.ECB, padding: CryptoJS.pad.NoPadding };
// Multiply in GF(2^128) using GCM's bit ordering.
const blocks = Math.ceil(nBytes / 16), out = [], src = srcWords.slice(0);
for (let w = 0; w < 4; w++) out.push(((src[b * 4 + w] | 0) ^ ks[w]) >>> 0);
if (ivWA.sigBytes !== 12) throw new Error('SBI GCM expects a 96-bit (12-byte) IV');
const E = blockEncryptor(keyWA), H = E([0, 0, 0, 0]), J0 = j0(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(ivUtf8));
const ctWords = ctrXor(E, J0, pt.words, pt.sigBytes);
const S = ghash(H, padded.concat(lenBlock(pt.sigBytes))), T = E(J0);
const ct = wa(all.words.slice(0, Math.ceil(n / 4)), n); ct.clamp();
const pt = wa(ctrXor(E, J0, ct.words, n), n); pt.clamp();

const E = blockEncryptor(keyWA), H = E([0, 0, 0, 0]), J0 = j0(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(ivUtf8));
const ctWords = ctrXor(E, J0, pt.words, pt.sigBytes);
const S = ghash(H, padded.concat(lenBlock(pt.sigBytes))), T = E(J0);

const pt = wa(ctrXor(E, J0, ct.words, n), n); pt.clamp();

request.description:
Request and response bodies are both a single `{ "ciphertext": "..." }` field: **AES-256-GCM**, base64 of `ciphertext || 16-byte tag`, no AAD, using the fixed UAT key and 96-bit IV from the kit's *GCM Encryption details.txt*.

Postman ships crypto-js, which has no GCM mode, so the pre-request script implements GCM (CTR + GHASH) on top of crypto-js' single-block AES. It was verified by round-tripping SBI's own sample ciphertext byte-for-byte.

The test script decrypts the response and stores `pdf2DocBase64`.

> `AgreementCode` is zero-padded to 7 digits here (`0006660`), unlike the quote and issuance services which take `6660`.
